# Python dependency pin for the CI verification jobs.
# capstone is the ONLY external pip dependency of this project (SH-2 disassembly
# backend for tools/disasm_sh2e.py / tools/rom_rebuild.py); there is no
# repo-root requirements file, so CI keeps its own pin here.
#
# CI pins capstone 5.0.9. VERIFICATION.md quotes the 5.0.7 measurement it was
# originally validated against; the local install may differ (check
# `python3 -c 'import capstone; print(capstone.__version__)'`) — see
# .github/workflows/README.md.
capstone==5.0.9
